value.text:
The Institut universitaire de technologie de l'Oise is a higher education institute attached to the université de Picardie Jules-Verne in France. It has sites in Beauvais and Creil. The Beauvais site has a building described as boat-shaped, while the Creil establishment is located in Parc Rouher. The institute offers programmes at BAC+2 and BAC+3 level, including work-study courses.

The institute was established in 1991. Its creation formed part of the université 2000 plan, which sought to develop opportunities for young people from Picardy to study within the region. The business and administration management department opened at Beauvais in 1992, followed by a marketing department in 1994. The institute occupied university branch premises from 1994 and moved into premises assigned to it in September 1996. An environmental health and safety programme was created in 1999.

The programmes described for Beauvais include business and administration management and marketing. Those described for Creil include marketing, logistics and transport management, and environmental health and safety. Professional licence courses cover areas including commercial development, management control, accounting and payroll, human resources, logistics systems, and the safety of people and property.
